title: Kerala child rights panel files case against ex-Minister K.T. Jaleel over ‘reprimanding’ student in public
summary: The former Higher Education Minister allegedly rebuked a student and held his ear during a felicitation function. He says he often use humour, friendly admonition and conversation to encourage students while pointing out their shortcomings. MSF accuses Jaleel of publicly humiliating the student.

title: NIA court issues non-bailable warrant against LeT founder Hafiz Saeed
summary: Saeed, designated a global terrorist by India and the United States, is also considered the mastermind of the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks

title: Amaravati Championship-2026 introduces U-17 and U-23 categories to boost youth participation
summary: The championship, which will be inaugurated by Sports Minister Mandipalli Ramprasad Reddy, will feature competitions in 12 sports disciplines, including basketball, kabaddi, hockey, weightlifting, and athletics

title: Can biogas aid India’s energy security?
summary: India, which imports nearly 85% of its crude oil needs, remains vulnerable to global energy shocks. Over the years, it has pushed several initiatives to promote compressed biogas. Despite these efforts, progress has been limited; government support and incentives could provide a boost to the sector

title: Bihar Environment Minister inaugurates ‘Ecotourism Investors Meet-2026’
summary: Aims to boost ecotourism with private investors’ participation for developing sites. Ecotourism destinations are divided into two groups for their development. Group A includes 29 ‘Reservoir-based ecotourism projects’ ; Group B includes 247 projects, including ponds, lakes, and wetlands

title: India-Australia ‘administrative arrangements’ for uranium supplies | Explained
summary: The recent agreement paves the way for Australian uranium exports to India, allowing private sector collaboration under stringent IAEA oversight

title: Delhi High Court tells social media platforms to act on Sunil Gavaskar’s personality rights plea
summary: The Court directed the social media intermediaries to treat Sunil Gavaskar’s suit as a complaint under the Information and Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021, and take necessary steps within seven days

title: Bihar CM launches Heli-Tourism and Air Tourism Service Scheme-2026
summary: Bookings commenced on July 13, 2026, and helicopter services will be available every Saturday and Sunday starting July 18, 2026
